summary: Potential evaluated at caller-supplied coordinates, so the client can colour its own surface mesh.
description: DECLARED HERE, NOT YET REGISTERED AT RUNTIME. This method lives in the physics daemon, which has no method registry: no method_id, no implementation version, no descriptor, and an in-process job queue that does not survive a restart. ADR-002 makes this manifest the authority, so declaring it is correct — and saying that it is unregistered is the difference between a plan and a claim.

dimensionality.description: 3 ONLY. A 2D structure must not reach a 3D physics method; molecule.embed is the explicit step that produces 3D, and an implicit SMILES→3D would report one method having run when two did.

basis.description: METHOD-SPECIFIC, deliberately. The global Basis union was already false: the physics daemon accepts def2-tzvp and the fields daemon does not.

refusals.condition: the requested basis does not describe every element present
refusals.measured: 6-31g has no iodine ECP; without one iodine runs all-electron and the potential is wrong by 58 kcal/mol with no error raised

refusals.condition: a transition metal is present and spin was not supplied
refusals.measured: electron parity implies a closed-shell singlet that is not the ground state; collapsing this into UNSUPPORTED reads as "give up" rather than "answer one question"

refusals.condition: DIIS stalls and the second-order (newton) rescue also fails
refusals.measured: a field rendered from an unconverged wavefunction is visually indistinguishable from a converged one

refusals.condition: the pre-flight estimate exceeds compute_budget_seconds, or the in-loop watchdog fires
refusals.measured: estimate 2.8 x 5.9e-9 x nao^4.03 s, fitted over 47 molecules; the 2.8x factor is the measured underestimate mid-range
beyond that, HF on this box is not interactive at any basis

warnings.meaning: Orbital energies are not quantitatively quotable at this basis.
warnings.measured: STO-3G ranks nitrobenzene as more electron-rich than benzene while def2-SVP ranks it last; water's LUMO moves 12 eV
